limitations: These are compiler/CLI replays and source reconstructions, not app acceptance or browser assertions.
N_ROLE_UNFILTERED uses the documented exact ownership-column/role-enum spelling relationship; it does not infer arbitrary customer/staff vocabulary.
Typed record-list input remains unsupported; the new diagnostic and supported alternative were checked.
Bracket != requires a complete unique key, a required scalar field and non-null literal; ordinary pages use where, nullable fields require explicit program guards.
Program payload-hidden predicates return false; rule predicates over protected fields refuse E_COLUMN_READ.
New bracket predicates remain outside the Lean model fragment (read-form / rule-probe-form); finite core-interpreter tests cover them.
